description: An item's metadata and data, or part of its data (pointer or path), at its current or an older version. Returns the etag to pass as ifMatch when writing a change based on what you read, and the guarded pointers whose values this token can't see. A version older than the plan keeps fails with ITEM_VERSION_NOT_RETAINED: read it from its event with get_event instead. 1 request, plus 1 the first time a list is used in a session (unless get_list was called).

includeGuarded.description: Only when this server acts as an identity: include guarded values in the items that identity owns

item.description: The item: its id or alias value (a deleted item only by id)

list.description: The list: its id or pathName

path.description: A JSONPath selecting part of the data, e.g. $.tasks[*].title (instead of pointer)

pointer.description: A JSON pointer (RFC 6901) into the item's data, e.g. /address/city or /scores/0. Leave out for the whole data

name: get_item
title: Get an item
